dish.note: Mango and lime folded through whipped cream, layered with crushed shortbread.
dish.how: Blend the flesh of 3 ripe mangoes with the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp icing sugar to a smooth purée. Whip 300ml cream to soft peaks, fold in 150g Greek yoghurt and two thirds of the purée, and a teaspoon of Kakadu plum powder if you have it. Layer into 4 glasses with 6 crushed shortbread biscuits and the rest of the purée, and chill 30 minutes.

steps.text: Blend the mango, lime juice and icing sugar to a purée.
Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold in the yoghurt and most of the purée.
Layer into glasses with the crushed shortbread and the rest of the purée.
